Thanks for sending this over, Danielle — quick follow-ups before I hand it to Finance/Procurement: 

1) Can you confirm that the EIN on the bank letter exactly matches the EIN on the W-9? I spot-checked and the numbers look the same, but our Finance team requires either a notarized W-9 or a bank letter that explicitly says "Tax ID/EIN" in the body.
2) Who is the authorized signer on the W-9? Please include title and a dated signature page.
3) Do you have an invoice remit address that differs from the legal address? If so, share that so we can include it on the PO.

If you can provide a notarized W-9 or an additional confirmation document, we'll prioritize the PO creation this week. Copying Ben from Finance — Ben, once we have the notarized W-9 or an explicit EIN bank letter we can move to create PO.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
